references.text: Jarmuth is mentioned as one of the cities of the five Amorite kings who formed a coalition against Gibeon, and Joshua defeated them.
Jarmuth is listed among the cities whose kings were defeated by Joshua.
Adullam is known as the place where David hid in a cave when he fled from Saul.
Aseka is mentioned as a place where the Lord cast large stones from heaven on the enemies during Joshua's battle.
Socoh is mentioned in connection with the Philistine camp when Goliath challenged Israel.
Adullam is mentioned as one of the places that were inhabited after the return from Babylon.
Aseka is mentioned as one of the last fortified cities in Judah that resisted the Babylonians.
Adullam is mentioned in the prophecy that the glory of Israel shall come there.
